entities.summary: Eduardo Tomás Medina-Mora Icaza is a Mexican lawyer, politician and diplomat. He served as a Justice of the Supreme Court of Mexico from 10 March 2015 to 8 October 2019, when the Mexican Senate approved his resignation following a now closed investigation by the country's Financial Intelligence Unit.
